_about: John Jewel (1522-1571), Bishop of Salisbury. The target is the Parker Society Works, ed. John Ayre (4 'portions', Cambridge 1845-1850), Internet Archive OCR, raw; each title page read. The Toronto set lacks a readable vol. 3, so vol. 3 is Princeton's copy. Jelf's Oxford edition (8 vols, 1848) is listed as an alternate, not fetched. No CCEL or Gutenberg Jewel exists.

jewel-ps-02: Works of John Jewel, Second Portion: Reply to Harding's Answer (concluded), Sermons, ed. John Ayre (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1847), vol. 2
jewel-ps-03: Works of John Jewel, Third Portion: Apologia Ecclesiae Anglicanae, Defence of the Apology I-III, ed. John Ayre (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1848), vol. 3
jewel-ps-04: Works of John Jewel, Fourth Portion: Defence of the Apology IV-VI, Epistle to Scipio, View of a Seditious Bull, ed. John Ayre (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1850), vol. 4
